title: Q: Formatting Limezu' Modern Tileset Series

posts.author: Reptar
posts.body:
Hi All, I'm returning to RPG Maker MZ after about a ten year hiatus (and then I was on MV) -- and stumbling over something I'm sure is simple: setting up imported custom tilesets in the database. I can import them through the Resource Manager just fine. But once I pull it up in the database, it's inevitably incomplete, off centered, the wrong size, etc. Part of the problem is the tilesets are massive -- I'm using Limezu's Modern series (Modern Exteriors, Interiors, Farm). So I assume I can't use everything (?) and need to manually create a new tileset of the things I like using something like Photoshop.
I have templates for A-BCDE tileset categories, uploaded into a document that is 768x768pi (the largest required dimensions) and aligned accordingly with 48x48pi tiles. But when I upload a file, say "1_Terrains...48x48.png," it still doesn't seem to line up correctly.
If I can't get that lined up, I certainly can't splice together a tileset combining the various parts I want... And if I can't do that, I can't test if it formats correctly into the Database...
... And I can't even just test the custom tilesets as is, because Limezu's created so many assets that there's far too many to use (unless I'm missing something there too...) and so they don't format correctly either. My read is that you're supposed to cut them up into what you want, which brings me back to the initial problem. And, bless him, even the conveniently sorted thematized folders within each asset have more and are bigger than what can be directly accepted by the Database.
... never mind that they're not all labeled A1, A2, etc consistently as far as I can tell and are mostly named by topic ("Garage_Sale_2_48x48.png").
I know this is something stupid simple but I can't work it out after searching the internet forever. Any search for how to format or import tilesets inevitably brings me back to the literal process of using the Resource manager (which I know how to do) or glosses over the part I apparently can't do with a cheery "combine and size your tileset with photoshop, then..." without addressing the how.
Save me, Obi-Forum Members, you're my sanity's onlyhope.
PS:
I could attach an example tileset but Idk if that is technically inappropriately sharing Limezu's work? You can download it for free but Idk if that's considered different from public distribution?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: In the download link it should have a download for RPG Maker formatted assets. You need to use those
